bundle.shortDescription: Collaborative editor for LaTeX, Typst, Quarto, Markdown and HTML projects
bundle.longDescription:
LibrePaper is a desktop app for writing and reviewing documents with
collaborators. It connects to a LibrePaper server and adds what a browser
cannot do: run R and Python code, work with AI agents, pull citations from
Zotero, sync with Git, keep local backups and render with your own latexmk,
Typst or Quarto.
